summary: Add deterministic explicit question-part coverage to the QA V3 answer contract.
decision_refs: The fixed Flash/Pro benchmark showed both models omitted the explicitly requested door-thickness field while still returning structurally valid answers.
The user directed CIRP development, testing and iteration to continue before another provider benchmark.
Ponytail constraint: use a local question checklist and existing claims/calculations instead of another model, semantic database or grading framework.

approval_evidence: The user asked the planned CIRP development and iteration to continue and allowed API use, while local gates remain the first step.
known_limitations: The checklist recognizes only explicit comma lists and parallel question clauses; it does not perform semantic decomposition.
A provider can map a claim to a part incorrectly, so existing citation and numeric validation still apply and human benchmark adjudication remains required.
Multiple requirements nested inside one part, such as two distinct frame-paint notes, are not separately enforced by this increment.
No provider call was made, and historical evaluation results are not rewritten.
